memories.title: The Day We Met
memories.description: The moment that changed everything. I remember the exact look on your face and how nervous I was to talk to you. It was the best day of my year.

memories.title: First Photo Together
memories.description: We were both so shy, but look at us now! It's still one of my absolute favorite pictures of us.

memories.title: Funniest Moment
memories.description: I still laugh out loud when I think of this day. You have the most contagious laugh in the world.

memories.title: Favorite Memory
memories.description: Just you, me, and a perfect quiet afternoon. No distractions, just talking and feeling completely at peace with each other.

memories.title: Today
memories.description: Every single day with you is a brand new adventure. I can't wait for all the beautiful memories we have yet to create.

playlist.title: I Think They Call This Love

stars: One thing I admire about you... Your boundless empathy and how deeply you care for everyone around you.
A memory that still makes me smile... The time we got caught in the rain and ended up laughing instead of running.
Something I hope you achieve... All your big dreams in your career, because you deserve it more than anyone.
Something I never want you to forget... That you are loved exactly for who you are, every single day.
